result.summary: Found 4 issues: primarily layout/content truncation problems affecting the horizontal category filter and restaurant carousel, plus a minor navigation state issue.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' restaurant card 'Trattoria Piccolo' is cut off at the right edge of the screen, showing only a partial image and truncated name.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scroll containers clip cleanly or add a visual cue (fade/gradient) indicating more content is scrollable, and truncate text with ellipsis instead of hard cropping.

issues.description: The category filter row (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) shows a partially visible additional category chip cut off at the right edge.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade/gradient overlay at the edge or ensure consistent padding so cut-off elements are intentional and clearly scrollable.

issues.description: The 'Profile' tab icon and label are highlighted green in the bottom navigation, but the visible page content is the Home/Discovery screen, creating inconsistency between active tab state and displayed content.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the highlighted bottom navigation tab matches the currently displayed screen content.

issues.description: The second promotional restaurant card at the bottom (pizza image with -20% badge) is cut off with no visible restaurant name or details before the screen ends.
issues.suggestion: Ensure adequate spacing or scroll padding so card content is not abruptly cut at the viewport boundary without indication of continuation.
